plan.question: What is the nutrition screening coverage percentage and the number of completed anaemia referrals for each block in the selected year?

view.title: Nutrition Screening Coverage and Completed Referrals by Block
view.note: Select a year to see screening coverage (%) and the number of completed anaemia referrals for each block. The coverage data comes from the "Quarterly Review" sheet, Table 1, range "Quarterly Review!A1:C7". The referral data comes from the same sheet, Table 2, range "Quarterly Review!E1:G7".

interpretation_guard.caveat: The file does not provide information on why coverage or referral numbers vary.

critic.feedback: The plan mixes a percentage and a raw number on the same y‑axis and labels the unit as percent only, which is misleading. It also does not explicitly state that the user can filter by year. The source ranges are correct, but the chart type should accommodate two different units (e.g., dual‑axis or separate charts).
